summary: Block 18A is a UCSF parcel in Mission Bay's North Campus, designated Research in UCSF's Long Range Development Plan as listed in its June 2025 presentation, which says UCSF has 'no building plans at Mission Bay right now'. UCSF's January 2018 environmental notice describes it as a 'temporary shuttle yard' until the lot is 'developed with permanent uses'; no project, developer or date is stated in any source found.

milestones.text: UCSF's September 13, 2016 Note to File analysed temporary shuttle parking on Block 18 (recounted in Addendum #4)

UCSF files a Notice of Determination to install temporary electric-vehicle charging in about 30 shuttle parking spaces at the 'Block 18A temporary shuttle yard, until such time that the lot is developed with permanent uses'
UCSF's Mission Bay CAC presentation lists 'Block 18A – Research' among undeveloped parcels remaining 'per UCSF's Long Range Development Plan' and states 'No building plans at Mission Bay right now'

facts.value: Research (UCSF June 2025 presentation, citing its Long Range Development Plan)
Temporary shuttle yard (UCSF notice, January 2018), 'until such time that the lot is developed with permanent uses'

None stated for this block. UCSF's June 12, 2025 Mission Bay CAC presentation says 'No building plans at Mission Bay right now'; the only date in it, 'After 2035', is attached to South Campus Phase 2 (hospital, parking), not to this block

open_questions: No source found states when Block 18A research space will be built, by whom, or how large: UCSF's June 2025 deck lists the use and says it has no building plans at Mission Bay right now.
Whether the temporary shuttle yard of 2016-2018 is still the block's use in 2026 is not stated in any document read.
The 2014 Long Range Development Plan itself could not be opened here (UCSF Real Estate pages returned a block page); its Block 18A use comes from UCSF's 2025 deck.
The 18A/18B boundary and the 'A/B' naming come from the OCII land use map and UCSF's deck; no source read gives a dimensioned boundary.
The OCII land use map labels the parcel 18A (colour fill is graphic, not read as text).
